blocks.zh: 附錄二：專案執行計畫 (PEP) 範例
blocks.en: Appendix 2: Project Execution Plan (PEP) Example

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 Project Execution Plan (PEP) 的目的、結構與在一次性使用系統 (SUS) 專案中的角色
blocks.en: Understand the purpose and structure of the Project Execution Plan (PEP) and its role in a single-use systems (SUS) project

blocks.zh: 掌握 PEP 中專案範圍 (Scope)、執行策略 (Execution Approach) 與品質策略 (Quality Strategy) 的核心要素
blocks.en: Master the core elements of the PEP: project scope, execution approach, and quality strategy

blocks.zh: 學習如何規劃 Commissioning and Qualification (C&Q) 流程，包含 FAT、SAT、IQ、OQ 的執行方式
blocks.en: Learn how to plan the Commissioning and Qualification (C&Q) process, including how FAT, SAT, IQ, and OQ are executed

blocks.zh: 瞭解 Supervising Engineering Contractor (SEC) 與業主之間的角色分工與責任劃分
blocks.en: Understand the division of roles and responsibilities between the Supervising Engineering Contractor (SEC) and the owner

blocks.zh: 認識變更管理 (Change Management)、風險管理 (Risk Management) 與文件管控 (Document Control) 在專案中的實務應用
blocks.en: Recognize the practical application of change management, risk management, and document control in a project

blocks.zh: 本節目錄 Table of Contents
blocks.en: Table of Contents

blocks.zh: 9.1 Introduction 9.1 導論
blocks.en: 9.1 Introduction

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Project Execution Plan / PEP (專案執行計畫)：PEP 是整個 SUS 建廠或改造專案的「作戰計畫書」，涵蓋範圍定義、執行策略、品質管控與時程管理。它不是一份寫了就束之高閣的文件，而是一份「活的文件 (Living Document)」，隨專案進展持續更新。
blocks.en: Project Execution Plan / PEP: The PEP is the "battle plan" for an entire SUS facility build or retrofit project, covering scope definition, execution approach, quality control, and schedule management. It is not a document that is written and then shelved; it is a "living document" that is updated continuously as the project progresses.

blocks.zh: Supervising Engineering Contractor / SEC (監督工程承包商)：在大型製藥工程專案中，業主通常委託 SEC 來統籌設計、採購、施工與確效等工作。SEC 扮演專案管理的核心角色。
blocks.en: Supervising Engineering Contractor / SEC: In large pharmaceutical engineering projects, the owner usually appoints an SEC to coordinate design, procurement, construction, and validation. The SEC plays the central project management role.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: PEP 就像蓋房子時的「施工藍圖+工程管理計畫」。想像你要裝修一間新餐廳：你需要一份文件說明「要做什麼（範圍）」、「怎麼做（策略）」、「誰負責什麼（組織）」、「品質怎麼控管」、「時程怎麼安排」。PEP 就是把這些全部整合在一份主文件中，讓所有利害關係人有共同的依據。
blocks.en: A PEP is like the "construction drawings plus the construction management plan" for building a house. Imagine fitting out a new restaurant: you need a document that explains what is to be done (scope), how it will be done (approach), who is responsible for what (organization), how quality will be controlled, and how the schedule will run. The PEP integrates all of this in one master document so that every stakeholder works from the same basis.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: PEP 的「活文件」特性非常重要。在 SUS 專案中，由於一次性技術的供應商生態系仍在快速演進，專案執行過程中經常需要調整設計或供應商選擇。PEP 必須有明確的版本管控 (Revision Control) 機制，確保每次變更都經過正式審核與批准。
blocks.en: The "living document" nature of the PEP is very important. In SUS projects, the supplier ecosystem for single-use technology is still evolving quickly, so design or supplier choices often need to be adjusted during execution. The PEP must have a clear revision control mechanism so that every change goes through formal review and approval.

blocks.zh: 請注意：PEP 可以由最終使用者 (End User) 或其委託的工程公司/供應商來撰寫，但無論誰撰寫，業主都必須審核並批准。
blocks.en: Note that the PEP may be written by the end user or by an engineering firm/supplier appointed by the end user, but whoever writes it, the owner must review and approve it.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼 PEP 被定義為「活文件」？在 SUS 專案中，哪些因素最可能觸發 PEP 的修訂？
blocks.en: Why is the PEP defined as a "living document"? In an SUS project, which factors are most likely to trigger a revision of the PEP?

blocks.zh: 如果 PEP 附錄中的一份參考文件被修訂了，PEP 主文件是否也需要修訂？為什麼？
blocks.en: If a reference document in a PEP appendix is revised, does the main PEP also need to be revised? Why?

blocks.zh: 9.2 Project Overview 9.2 專案概述
blocks.en: 9.2 Project Overview

blocks.zh: Gene Therapy (基因治療) 與 SUS 的關聯：此範例非常典型地展示了為什麼 SUS 特別適合基因治療產品。病毒載體 (Viral Vector) 製造涉及活病毒操作，需要高生物安全等級 (BSL) 的環境。使用一次性系統可以大幅降低交叉污染風險，並簡化清潔驗證的複雜度。
blocks.en: Gene therapy and SUS: This example shows very typically why SUS is particularly suited to gene therapy products. Viral vector manufacturing involves handling live virus and requires an environment with a high biosafety level (BSL). Single-use systems can greatly reduce the risk of cross-contamination and simplify the complexity of cleaning validation.

blocks.zh: Steering Committee (指導委員會)：由 SEC 與業主共同組成的最高決策機構，負責監督專案進度、審批計畫變更、管控預算與時程。
blocks.en: Steering Committee: The highest decision-making body, formed jointly by the SEC and the owner, responsible for overseeing project progress, approving plan changes, and controlling budget and schedule.

blocks.zh: 把這個專案想像成「從傳統瓷器餐廳改造成使用免洗餐具的外送廚房」。Company X 原本規劃了傳統不鏽鋼 (non-SUS) 的產線，但後來決定改用一次性技術。建築已經蓋好了（就像廚房空間已經有了），現在要做的是把裡面的設備全部用一次性系統來重新設計和安裝。
blocks.en: Think of this project as "converting a traditional china-plate restaurant into a delivery kitchen that uses disposable tableware." Company X had originally planned a conventional stainless steel (non-SUS) line but later decided to adopt single-use technology. The building is already built (like a kitchen space that already exists), and the task now is to redesign and install all the equipment inside as single-use systems.

blocks.zh: 請特別注意專案時程目標：從 Basic Design 開始到 OQ 完成，僅有 18 個月。這在傳統不鏽鋼產線幾乎不可能達成，但 SUS 因為省去了大量管路安裝、焊接檢查與 CIP/SIP 驗證，大幅縮短了建廠時程。這正是 SUS 的核心商業優勢之一。
blocks.en: Pay particular attention to the project schedule target: only 18 months from the start of Basic Design to completion of OQ. This would be almost impossible with a traditional stainless steel line, but SUS removes a great deal of piping installation, weld inspection, and CIP/SIP validation, greatly shortening the build schedule. This is one of the core business advantages of SUS.

blocks.zh: Steering Committee 的設置也值得學習：它確保了 SEC 與業主之間有結構化的溝通管道，避免因資訊不對稱而導致的專案延誤或品質問題。
blocks.en: The Steering Committee is also worth learning from: it gives the SEC and the owner a structured communication channel and avoids project delays or quality problems caused by information asymmetry.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 作為 CDMO，如果你要為客戶建置一條基因治療的 SUS 產線，這份 PEP 範例提供了非常好的結構參考。你可以直接套用其範圍定義、組織架構和品質策略的框架，再根據自身需求調整細節。特別是 Steering Committee 的設計，在 CDMO 與 Sponsor 之間的協作中尤為重要。
blocks.en: As a CDMO, if you are building a gene therapy SUS line for a client, this PEP example offers an excellent structural reference. You can apply its framework for scope definition, organization, and quality strategy directly and then adjust the details to your own needs. The Steering Committee design in particular is important for collaboration between a CDMO and a sponsor.

blocks.zh: 9.3 Contract Documents 9.3 合約文件
blocks.en: 9.3 Contract Documents

blocks.zh: Contract Documents (合約文件)：這裡區分了 Basic Design（基本設計）和 Detailed Design and Execution（細部設計與執行）兩個階段的合約文件。這種分階段簽約的方式在大型製藥工程中很常見，可以降低業主的風險。
blocks.en: Contract Documents: This section distinguishes the contract documents for two phases: Basic Design and Detailed Design and Execution. Contracting in phases like this is common in large pharmaceutical engineering projects and can reduce the owner's risk.

blocks.zh: User Requirement / UR (使用者需求)：由業主提供的需求規格書，是整個設計的基礎。在 SUS 專案中，UR 需要特別涵蓋一次性組件的材質相容性、萃取物/浸出物規格等特殊要求。
blocks.en: User Requirement / UR: The requirements specification provided by the owner, which is the foundation of the whole design. In an SUS project, the UR needs to cover special requirements such as material compatibility of single-use components and extractables/leachables specifications.

blocks.zh: 合約文件就像婚前協議書：在專案「結婚」之前，雙方必須清楚約定各自的責任、交付物和權利義務。Basic Design 階段的合約就像「訂婚」，先確認大方向；Detailed Design 階段的合約則是「正式結婚」，把所有細節都寫清楚。
blocks.en: Contract documents are like a prenuptial agreement: before the project "marries," both parties must clearly agree on their responsibilities, deliverables, and rights and obligations. The Basic Design contract is like the "engagement," confirming the general direction; the Detailed Design contract is the "wedding," where every detail is written out.

blocks.zh: 注意 Customer X 的交付責任中包括「Process know-how and product requirements」。這在 SUS 專案中特別重要，因為一次性組件的選擇（如袋材、管路材質）必須基於製程需求和產品特性。業主如果無法及時提供這些資訊，將直接影響 SEC 的設計工作。
blocks.en: Note that Customer X's delivery responsibilities include "Process know-how and product requirements." This is especially important in an SUS project because the selection of single-use components (such as bag film and tubing material) must be based on process needs and product characteristics. If the owner cannot supply this information on time, it directly affects the SEC's design work.

blocks.zh: 為什麼要將合約文件分成 Basic Design 和 Detailed Design 兩個階段？這對專案風險管理有什麼好處？
blocks.en: Why split the contract documents into two phases, Basic Design and Detailed Design? What benefit does this have for project risk management?

blocks.zh: 如果業主延遲提供製程知識 (Process Know-how)，對 SUS 專案會造成哪些連鎖影響？
blocks.en: If the owner delays providing process know-how, what knock-on effects does this have on an SUS project?

blocks.zh: 9.4 Scope 9.4 範圍
blocks.en: 9.4 Scope

blocks.zh: Value Engineering (價值工程)：在不降低功能和品質的前提下，尋找降低成本的替代方案。在 SUS 專案中，這可能包括評估不同供應商的一次性組件、優化管路配置以減少接頭數量等。
blocks.en: Value Engineering: Looking for lower-cost alternatives without reducing function or quality. In an SUS project, this may include evaluating single-use components from different suppliers and optimizing the piping layout to reduce the number of connections.

blocks.zh: Project Baseline (專案基線)：經過批准的 Basic Design 文件構成專案基線。任何偏離基線的變更都必須走正式的變更管理程序。這是防止 Scope Creep（範圍蔓延）的關鍵機制。
blocks.en: Project Baseline: The approved Basic Design documents form the project baseline. Any change that deviates from the baseline must go through the formal change management procedure. This is the key mechanism for preventing scope creep.

blocks.zh: Design Steps（設計步驟）：Front-end Definition → Basic Design → Detailed Design 是標準的三階段設計流程。每個階段的細緻程度逐步增加，也代表著投入的資源和承諾逐步加深。
blocks.en: Design Steps: Front-end Definition → Basic Design → Detailed Design is the standard three-phase design process. The level of detail increases at each phase, and so do the resources invested and the commitment made.

blocks.zh: 設計三階段就像畫一幅油畫：Front-end Definition 是構圖（確定要畫什麼）、Basic Design 是素描底稿（確定比例和結構）、Detailed Design 是上色完稿（所有細節都到位）。如果底稿畫錯了，上色階段再改就非常昂貴。這就是為什麼 Basic Design 階段的審核和批准如此重要。
blocks.en: The three design phases are like painting an oil painting: Front-end Definition is the composition (deciding what to paint), Basic Design is the pencil underdrawing (fixing proportions and structure), and Detailed Design is the finished colored work (every detail in place). If the underdrawing is wrong, correcting it during the coloring stage is very expensive. This is why review and approval at the Basic Design phase matter so much.

blocks.zh: SUS 專案中 Disposables 的特殊考量：注意 9.4.4.4 提到一次性袋子「僅在 IQ 和 OQ 必要時提供有限數量」。這是因為一次性組件有保質期限制，如果太早大量採購，可能在 PQ 或正式生產前就過期了。SUS 專案的採購策略必須考慮組件的 shelf life。
blocks.en: Special considerations for disposables in SUS projects: Note that 9.4.4.4 says single-use bags are provided "in limited quantities, only where necessary for IQ and OQ." This is because single-use components have a limited shelf life; if they are bought in large quantities too early, they may expire before PQ or routine production. The procurement strategy for an SUS project must take component shelf life into account.

blocks.zh: 文件優先順序原則：當 Basic Design 文件與參考文件產生矛盾時，參考文件優先（除非被後續變更管理所取代）。這個原則確保了業主的原始需求不會被設計過程中的解讀所稀釋。
blocks.en: Document precedence principle: When the Basic Design documents conflict with the reference documents, the reference documents take precedence (unless superseded through later change management). This principle ensures that the owner's original requirements are not diluted by interpretation during the design process.

blocks.zh: 在 SUS 專案中，Value Engineering 可能帶來哪些具體的成本節約？請舉三個例子。
blocks.en: In an SUS project, what concrete cost savings can Value Engineering bring? Give three examples.

blocks.zh: 為什麼一次性袋子僅在 IQ/OQ 階段才提供有限數量？如果提早大量採購會有什麼風險？
blocks.en: Why are single-use bags provided only in limited quantities at the IQ/OQ stage? What are the risks of buying large quantities early?

blocks.zh: Change Management 為什麼被單獨列為一個章節？在 SUS 專案中，最常見的變更觸發原因是什麼？
blocks.en: Why is Change Management listed as a separate section? In an SUS project, what are the most common triggers for change?

blocks.zh: 9.5 Project Execution Approach 9.5 專案執行方法
blocks.en: 9.5 Project Execution Approach

blocks.zh: Concurrent Engineering (並行工程)：PEP 明確指出 DD、施工和 C&Q 將會重疊進行。這是「快速建廠 (Fast-Track Construction)」的核心策略，透過並行作業來壓縮整體時程。
blocks.en: Concurrent Engineering: The PEP states explicitly that DD, construction, and C&Q will overlap. This is the core strategy of fast-track construction: compressing the overall schedule through parallel working.

blocks.zh: As-Built Drawings (竣工圖)：施工過程中，實際安裝往往與原始設計有偏差。Redline（紅線標記）就是在現場直接在原圖上標記實際差異，最終由 SEC 正式重新出圖成為 As-Built 版本。
blocks.en: As-Built Drawings: During construction, the actual installation often deviates from the original design. Redlines mark these differences directly on the original drawings on site, and the SEC eventually reissues the drawings formally as the As-Built version.

blocks.zh: Design Disciplines（設計專業）：將工程拆分成建築、製程技術、公用設施和自動化四大領域，每個領域下再細分。這確保了每個專業都有對應的負責人 (Design Lead)。
blocks.en: Design Disciplines: The engineering work is split into four main areas (architecture, process technology, utilities, and automation), each further subdivided. This ensures that every discipline has a responsible Design Lead.

blocks.zh: 並行工程就像邊蓋房子邊裝潢：一樓還在砌牆的時候，二樓的設計圖已經在畫了。這種方式可以大幅縮短時程，但要求各團隊之間的溝通協調必須非常緊密，否則「一樓牆壁的管線預留孔」可能跟「二樓的管路設計」對不上。
blocks.en: Concurrent engineering is like fitting out a house while it is still being built: while the walls of the first floor are still going up, the drawings for the second floor are already being prepared. This can shorten the schedule substantially, but it demands very close communication and coordination between teams; otherwise the pipe penetrations left in the first-floor walls may not match the second-floor piping design.

blocks.zh: QA 獨立性：注意 9.5.2.2 特別強調 QA 在 DD 階段是以「獨立角色」參與審查 GMP 合規性。這符合 GMP 的基本原則——品質保證功能必須獨立於生產和工程，避免利益衝突。
blocks.en: QA independence: Note that 9.5.2.2 specifically stresses that QA takes part in the DD phase as an "independent role" reviewing GMP compliance. This follows the basic GMP principle that the quality assurance function must be independent of production and engineering to avoid conflicts of interest.

blocks.zh: 文件分級審批：並非所有設計文件都需要業主審批。僅「Governing Design Documents」（主要設計文件）才送交業主。純施工用的詳細圖紙由 SEC 內部管控。這是務實的做法，避免業主被大量文件淹沒。
blocks.en: Tiered document approval: Not every design document needs owner approval. Only the "Governing Design Documents" are sent to the owner. Detailed drawings used purely for construction are controlled internally by the SEC. This is a pragmatic approach that keeps the owner from being swamped with documents.

blocks.zh: 圖表解讀 Figure Analysis
blocks.en: Figure Analysis

blocks.zh: 專案階段流程圖清楚顯示了從 DD 到 Handover 的完整生命週期。關鍵里程碑包括：
blocks.en: The project phase flow chart clearly shows the full life cycle from DD to Handover. Key milestones include:

blocks.zh: Documented Mechanical Completion（文件化機械完工）：施工完成的正式確認點
blocks.en: Documented Mechanical Completion: The formal confirmation point that construction is complete

blocks.zh: ATO (Approval to Operate)：批准運轉的關鍵門檻，代表系統已通過 IQ/OQ
blocks.en: ATO (Approval to Operate): The key threshold for approval to operate, indicating that the system has passed IQ/OQ

blocks.zh: CCC (Care, Custody, and Control)：系統從 SEC 移交給業主管理的轉折點
blocks.en: CCC (Care, Custody, and Control): The turning point at which the system passes from the SEC to the owner's management

blocks.zh: 為什麼 QA 要在 DD 階段就以獨立角色介入？如果等到 C&Q 階段才介入，可能會發生什麼問題？
blocks.en: Why should QA be involved as an independent role as early as the DD phase? What problems might occur if QA only becomes involved at the C&Q stage?

blocks.zh: Concurrent Engineering 在 SUS 專案中比傳統不鏽鋼專案更容易實施嗎？為什麼？
blocks.en: Is Concurrent Engineering easier to implement in an SUS project than in a traditional stainless steel project? Why?

blocks.zh: 9.5.3 – 9.5.4 Subcontracting, Procurement & Commissioning 9.5.3 – 9.5.4 分包、採購與試車
blocks.en: 9.5.3 – 9.5.4 Subcontracting, Procurement & Commissioning

blocks.zh: Impact Assessment（影響評估）：系統被分為三類——Direct Impact（直接影響）、Indirect Impact（間接影響）和 No Impact（無影響）。這個分類決定了 C&Q 的深度與嚴格程度：
blocks.en: Impact Assessment: Systems are classified into three categories: Direct Impact, Indirect Impact, and No Impact. This classification determines the depth and rigor of C&Q:

blocks.zh: Direct Impact：直接影響產品品質的系統（如生物反應器、充填設備），需要完整的 IQ/OQ
blocks.en: Direct Impact: Systems that directly affect product quality (such as bioreactors and filling equipment) require full IQ/OQ

blocks.zh: Indirect Impact：間接影響的系統（如 HVAC、純水系統），需要 FAT/SAT + Commissioning
blocks.en: Indirect Impact: Systems with indirect impact (such as HVAC and purified water systems) require FAT/SAT plus commissioning

blocks.zh: No Impact：不影響產品品質的系統（如照明），僅需按 GEP 標準進行調試
blocks.en: No Impact: Systems that do not affect product quality (such as lighting) only need to be commissioned according to GEP standards

blocks.zh: C-requirements vs Q-requirements：C-requirements 是透過 Commissioning 驗證的工程需求，Q-requirements 是透過正式 Qualification (IQ/OQ) 驗證的 GMP 需求。這種區分是 ASTM E2500 和 ISPE 推薦的基於科學和風險的確效方法。
blocks.en: C-requirements vs Q-requirements: C-requirements are engineering requirements verified through commissioning; Q-requirements are GMP requirements verified through formal qualification (IQ/OQ). This distinction is the science- and risk-based approach to verification recommended by ASTM E2500 and ISPE.

blocks.zh: Impact Assessment 就像醫院的感染風險分級：手術室（Direct Impact）需要最嚴格的消毒和監控、病房走廊（Indirect Impact）需要基本的清潔標準、停車場（No Impact）只需一般維護。每個區域的管控強度與其對患者安全的影響成正比。
blocks.en: Impact Assessment is like infection-risk tiering in a hospital: the operating room (Direct Impact) needs the strictest disinfection and monitoring, the ward corridor (Indirect Impact) needs basic cleaning standards, and the parking lot (No Impact) needs only general maintenance. The level of control in each area is proportional to its impact on patient safety.

blocks.zh: FAT/SAT 的 SUS 特殊性：在 SUS 專案中，FAT 通常在一次性組件供應商的工廠進行，重點驗證組件的品質管控系統和製造一致性；SAT 則在使用者現場驗證組件在實際製程條件下的表現。
blocks.en: The special nature of FAT/SAT in SUS: In an SUS project, FAT is usually performed at the single-use component supplier's plant and focuses on verifying the component quality control system and manufacturing consistency; SAT is performed at the user's site to verify how the components perform under actual process conditions.

blocks.zh: 採購以業主名義下單：雖然 SEC 負責採購，但訂單以 Company X 的名義下達。這確保了業主對供應商關係的最終控制權，也有利於保修和售後服務的銜接。
blocks.en: Procurement placed in the owner's name: Although the SEC is responsible for procurement, orders are placed in the name of Company X. This ensures that the owner keeps ultimate control of the supplier relationship and also helps with the handover of warranty and after-sales service.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 的 SUS 專案中，Impact Assessment 的結果直接決定了確效工作量和預算。一個常見的錯誤是將太多系統分類為 Direct Impact，導致確效成本膨脹。務實的做法是：嚴格按照系統對產品品質的實際影響來分類，並有科學依據支持分類決定。例如，SUS 的混合袋如果僅用於緩衝液配製，可以考慮分類為 Indirect Impact 而非 Direct Impact。
blocks.en: In a CDMO's SUS project, the result of the Impact Assessment directly determines the validation workload and budget. A common mistake is to classify too many systems as Direct Impact, which inflates validation cost. The pragmatic approach is to classify strictly according to each system's actual impact on product quality, with a scientific rationale supporting the classification decision. For example, if an SUS mixing bag is used only for buffer preparation, it could be classified as Indirect Impact rather than Direct Impact.

blocks.zh: 在一個 SUS 生物反應器系統中，哪些組件屬於 Direct Impact？哪些可能是 Indirect Impact？
blocks.en: In an SUS bioreactor system, which components are Direct Impact? Which might be Indirect Impact?

blocks.zh: 如果供應商無法在工廠進行 FAT，SEC 應該如何處理？這對專案時程有什麼影響？
blocks.en: If a supplier cannot perform FAT at its plant, how should the SEC handle it? What effect does this have on the project schedule?

blocks.zh: C-requirements 和 Q-requirements 的區分對確效效率有什麼實際好處？
blocks.en: What practical benefits does the distinction between C-requirements and Q-requirements bring to validation efficiency?

blocks.zh: 9.6 Organization 9.6 組織
blocks.en: 9.6 Organization

blocks.zh: RACI 式角色定義：雖然此表格沒有使用正式的 RACI 矩陣格式，但它清楚定義了每個角色的主要職責。在實際專案中，建議進一步將這些角色展開成 RACI 矩陣（Responsible 負責、Accountable 當責、Consulted 諮詢、Informed 知會），以避免責任模糊。
blocks.en: RACI-style role definitions: Although this table does not use a formal RACI matrix format, it clearly defines the main responsibilities of each role. In an actual project, it is advisable to expand these roles further into a RACI matrix (Responsible, Accountable, Consulted, Informed) to avoid ambiguity in responsibilities.

blocks.zh: Clash Control（衝突檢查）：Engineering Manager 負責「Physical Coordination」和「Clash Control」，這是指確保不同工程專業的設計在空間上不會互相衝突（例如管路穿過結構樑）。在 SUS 設施中，雖然製程管路減少了，但仍需注意 HVAC 管道、電纜架和一次性組件支撐架之間的空間協調。
blocks.en: Clash Control: The Engineering Manager is responsible for "Physical Coordination" and "Clash Control," which means making sure that the designs of different engineering disciplines do not conflict spatially (for example, piping running through a structural beam). Although an SUS facility has less process piping, spatial coordination is still needed among HVAC ducts, cable trays, and the support frames for single-use components.

blocks.zh: SEC 的組織就像一支足球隊：Project Manager 是總教練（統籌全局）、Engineering Manager 是隊長（協調各位置）、各 Design Leads 是各位置的專項教練（負責前鋒、中場、後衛的訓練）、QA 是裁判（獨立監督規則遵守）、Document Controller 是紀錄員（確保每場比賽的數據都被準確記錄）。
blocks.en: The SEC's organization is like a football team: the Project Manager is the head coach (overseeing the whole), the Engineering Manager is the captain (coordinating the positions), the Design Leads are the specialist coaches for each position (training the forwards, midfielders, and defenders), QA is the referee (independently overseeing compliance with the rules), and the Document Controller is the record keeper (making sure the data from every match is recorded accurately).

blocks.zh: 注意 C&Q Manager 的職責是「plan and coordinate testing」，而非「execute testing」。這意味著實際的測試執行可能由各 Design Lead 或分包商負責，C&Q Manager 負責的是整體計畫和協調。這種分工在大型專案中很常見，可以避免 C&Q Manager 成為瓶頸。
blocks.en: Note that the C&Q Manager's responsibility is to "plan and coordinate testing," not to "execute testing." This means the actual test execution may be carried out by the Design Leads or subcontractors, while the C&Q Manager handles overall planning and coordination. This division of work is common in large projects and prevents the C&Q Manager from becoming a bottleneck.

blocks.zh: 如果你是 CDMO 的專案負責人，你會在 SEC 的組織架構中額外增加什麼角色來確保 SUS 專案的特殊需求被滿足？
blocks.en: If you were the CDMO's project lead, what additional roles would you add to the SEC's organization to make sure the special needs of an SUS project are met?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 Project QA 需要同時對齊 SEC 的品質標準和 Company X 的法規要求？這兩者可能有什麼差異？
blocks.en: Why does Project QA need to align with both the SEC's quality standards and Company X's regulatory requirements? How might the two differ?

blocks.zh: 9.7 Quality 9.7 品質
blocks.en: 9.7 Quality

blocks.zh: VMP (Validation Master Plan / 驗證主計畫)：VMP 是整個驗證活動的最高層級文件，由業主 (Company X) 負責撰寫。它定義了驗證的範圍、策略、角色分工和接受標準。在此專案中，VMP 涵蓋設備確效 (IQ/OQ)，但製程驗證 (PV) 另立專屬 VMP。
blocks.en: VMP (Validation Master Plan): The VMP is the highest-level document for all validation activities and is written by the owner (Company X). It defines the validation scope, strategy, roles and responsibilities, and acceptance criteria. In this project, the VMP covers equipment qualification (IQ/OQ), while process validation (PV) has its own dedicated VMP.

blocks.zh: QAP (Quality Activity Plan / 品質活動計畫)：QAP 是 VMP 的執行層級文件，詳細列出每項品質活動、負責人、時程和交付物。可以把 VMP 視為「品質的憲法」，QAP 則是「品質的執行辦法」。
blocks.en: QAP (Quality Activity Plan): The QAP is the execution-level document under the VMP, listing in detail each quality activity, its owner, schedule, and deliverables. The VMP can be seen as the "constitution of quality" and the QAP as its "implementing rules."

blocks.zh: Supplier Qualification Synergy（供應商確效整合）：PEP 提出了一個非常務實的做法：將供應商的標準測試計畫整合到 SEC 的 IQ/OQ 方案中，避免重複測試。這在 SUS 專案中尤其重要，因為一次性組件供應商通常已經有完善的出廠測試程序。
blocks.en: Supplier Qualification Synergy: The PEP proposes a very pragmatic approach: integrating the supplier's standard test plan into the SEC's IQ/OQ package to avoid duplicate testing. This is especially important in SUS projects because single-use component suppliers usually already have well-established factory test procedures.

blocks.zh: VMP、QAP 和 IQ/OQ Protocol 的關係就像法律體系：VMP 是「憲法」（最高指導原則）、QAP 是「法律」（具體規範）、各個 IQ/OQ Protocol 是「作業標準程序」（具體執行步驟）。每一層都必須符合上一層的要求，不能互相矛盾。
blocks.en: The relationship among the VMP, the QAP, and the IQ/OQ Protocols is like a legal system: the VMP is the "constitution" (highest guiding principles), the QAP is the "law" (specific rules), and each IQ/OQ Protocol is the "standard operating procedure" (specific execution steps). Each level must comply with the one above and must not contradict it.

blocks.zh: SUS 專案中清潔驗證的簡化：注意 PEP 提到「cleaning validation」由 Company X 負責且不在此專案範圍內。在 SUS 設施中，由於使用一次性接液面組件，傳統意義上的清潔驗證大幅減少，但仍可能需要針對可重複使用的設備外部和環境進行清潔確效。
blocks.en: Simplified cleaning validation in SUS projects: Note that the PEP says "cleaning validation" is the responsibility of Company X and outside the scope of this project. In an SUS facility, because product-contact parts are single-use, cleaning validation in the traditional sense is greatly reduced, but cleaning validation may still be needed for the exterior of reusable equipment and for the environment.

blocks.zh: 確效分工的清晰界定：SEC 負責到 OQ，Company X 從 PQ 開始接手。這個交接點必須非常明確，因為 OQ 的完成品質直接影響 PQ 能否順利進行。
blocks.en: Clear delineation of validation responsibilities: The SEC is responsible up to OQ, and Company X takes over from PQ. This handover point must be very clear, because the quality of the completed OQ directly affects whether PQ can proceed smoothly.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 VMP 由業主撰寫而非 SEC？這對確效策略的制定有什麼影響？
blocks.en: Why is the VMP written by the owner rather than the SEC? How does this affect the formulation of the validation strategy?

blocks.zh: 將供應商測試計畫整合到 IQ/OQ 方案中有什麼好處？可能有什麼風險？
blocks.en: What are the benefits of integrating the supplier's test plan into the IQ/OQ package? What risks might there be?

blocks.zh: 在 SUS 專案中，清潔驗證的範圍與傳統不鏽鋼設施相比有何不同？
blocks.en: In an SUS project, how does the scope of cleaning validation differ from that of a traditional stainless steel facility?

blocks.zh: 9.8 Risk Management 9.8 風險管理
blocks.en: 9.8 Risk Management

blocks.zh: 分階段風險分析：PEP 規劃了四次風險分析，分別在 Basic Design (BD) 和 Detailed Design (DD) 階段進行。這體現了「漸進式風險管理」的原則——隨著設計細節的增加，風險分析的焦點也從宏觀（專案風險、佈局風險）轉向微觀（執行風險、HSE 風險）。
blocks.en: Phased risk analysis: The PEP plans four risk analyses, carried out during the Basic Design (BD) and Detailed Design (DD) phases. This reflects the principle of "progressive risk management": as design detail increases, the focus of risk analysis shifts from the macro level (project risk, layout risk) to the micro level (execution risk, HSE risk).

blocks.zh: BSL (Biosafety Level / 生物安全等級) Risk Analysis：由於本專案涉及活病毒操作，BSL 風險分析特別重要。它需要評估病毒逃逸風險、人員暴露風險以及環境釋放風險，並確保設施設計能夠有效控制這些風險。
blocks.en: BSL (Biosafety Level) Risk Analysis: Because this project involves handling live virus, BSL risk analysis is especially important. It must assess the risk of virus escape, personnel exposure, and environmental release, and ensure that the facility design controls these risks effectively.

blocks.zh: 分階段風險分析就像飛行員的「檢查清單」：起飛前有一份（BD Risk Analysis）、巡航時有一份（DD Risk Analysis）、準備降落時還有一份（HSE on Execution）。每個階段面對的風險不同，需要不同的檢查重點。不是做一次就夠了，而是在每個關鍵節點重新評估。
blocks.en: Phased risk analysis is like a pilot's checklist: one before takeoff (BD Risk Analysis), one during cruise (DD Risk Analysis), and another when preparing to land (HSE on Execution). Each phase faces different risks and needs different checking priorities. Doing it once is not enough; it must be reassessed at every key milestone.

blocks.zh: 電子記錄管理的前瞻性：9.8.1 強調在專案開始時就要規劃資料存儲。這在現代 GMP 環境中尤其重要，因為法規要求（如 21 CFR Part 11 和 EU GMP Annex 11）對電子記錄的完整性、可追溯性和長期保存有嚴格要求。專案關閉時如果發現文件缺失或格式不兼容，補救成本將非常高昂。
blocks.en: Foresight in electronic record management: 9.8.1 stresses planning data storage at the very start of the project. This is especially important in the modern GMP environment because regulatory requirements (such as 21 CFR Part 11 and EU GMP Annex 11) set strict expectations for the integrity, traceability, and long-term retention of electronic records. If missing documents or incompatible formats are discovered at project close-out, the cost of remediation will be very high.

blocks.zh: 在 SUS 專案中，哪些風險是傳統不鏽鋼專案不需要考慮的？（提示：供應鏈、組件相容性）
blocks.en: In an SUS project, which risks do traditional stainless steel projects not need to consider? (Hint: supply chain, component compatibility)

blocks.zh: 為什麼要在 Basic Design 階段就進行 BSL 和 GMP 風險分析？如果推遲到 Detailed Design 階段，可能會發生什麼？
blocks.en: Why perform BSL and GMP risk analysis as early as the Basic Design phase? What might happen if it is postponed to the Detailed Design phase?

blocks.zh: 9.9 Health, Safety, and Environment 9.9 健康、安全與環境
blocks.en: 9.9 Health, Safety, and Environment

blocks.zh: HSE (Health, Safety, and Environment / 健康、安全與環境)：HSE 計畫是法規強制要求的文件，在施工開始前必須批准。在涉及活病毒操作的 SUS 設施中，HSE 還需要特別考慮生物安全相關的風險，如病毒氣溶膠暴露、廢棄一次性組件的滅活處理等。
blocks.en: HSE (Health, Safety, and Environment): The HSE plan is a document required by regulation and must be approved before construction starts. In an SUS facility that handles live virus, HSE must also give special consideration to biosafety risks, such as exposure to viral aerosols and the inactivation of waste single-use components.

blocks.zh: HSE 計畫也是「活文件」，隨施工進展持續更新。這是因為施工現場的風險會隨著不同工序而變化——早期可能是結構施工風險，後期則可能涉及化學品和生物性物質的處理風險。
blocks.en: The HSE plan is also a living document, updated continuously as construction progresses. This is because the risks on a construction site change with each work activity: early on they may be structural construction risks, while later they may involve the handling of chemicals and biological materials.

blocks.zh: 9.10 Commissioning and Qualification 9.10 試車與確效
blocks.en: 9.10 Commissioning and Qualification

blocks.zh: C&Q 交接點：此節清楚劃定了 SEC 與 Company X 在確效活動中的分工界線。SEC 的責任止於 OQ 完成；OQ 之後的校正、維護和 PQ 全部由 Company X 接手。這是業界標準的交接模式。
blocks.en: C&Q handover point: This section clearly draws the dividing line between the SEC and Company X in validation activities. The SEC's responsibility ends when OQ is complete; calibration, maintenance, and PQ after OQ are all taken over by Company X. This is the standard handover model in the industry.

blocks.zh: 這就像買新車的交車流程：經銷商（SEC）負責到把車開到你面前、完成所有檢查（IQ/OQ）；交車之後的保養、加油和日常維護（PQ、校正、維護）就是車主（Company X）的責任了。但交車時雙方都要在場確認車況（Company X 的 QA 資源參與 OQ）。
blocks.en: This is like the handover process when buying a new car: the dealer (SEC) is responsible up to bringing the car to you and completing all the checks (IQ/OQ); after delivery, servicing, fueling, and routine maintenance (PQ, calibration, maintenance) are the owner's (Company X's) responsibility. But both parties must be present at delivery to confirm the condition of the car (Company X's QA resources take part in OQ).

blocks.zh: OQ 後的校正與維護責任轉移：這個細節很容易被忽略。Company X 必須在 OQ 完成前就建立起內部的校正和維護能力（包括 SOP、人員培訓和備件庫存），否則在 SEC 撤出後可能出現管理真空期。
blocks.en: Transfer of calibration and maintenance responsibility after OQ: This detail is easily overlooked. Company X must build its own calibration and maintenance capability (including SOPs, staff training, and spare parts inventory) before OQ is complete; otherwise a management vacuum may appear after the SEC withdraws.

blocks.zh: 9.11 Handover and Operation Support 9.11 移交與操作支援
blocks.en: 9.11 Handover and Operation Support

blocks.zh: 三階段移交 (Three-Step Handover)：
blocks.en: Three-Step Handover:

blocks.zh: Ready to Run（就緒運轉）：設備已安裝完成、通過 OQ，可以開始運轉
blocks.en: Ready to Run: Equipment is fully installed and has passed OQ, and operation can begin

blocks.zh: Handover（移交）：正式將系統的操作與維護責任從 SEC 轉移給 Company X
blocks.en: Handover: Responsibility for operating and maintaining the system is formally transferred from the SEC to Company X

blocks.zh: Final Handover（最終移交）：所有偏差處理完畢、文件齊全、保固轉移，專案正式結束
blocks.en: Final Handover: All deviations are closed, documentation is complete, the warranty is transferred, and the project formally ends

blocks.zh: Deviation Lists / Punch Lists（偏差清單/缺陷清單）：在移交前，會有一份列出所有待解決問題的清單。Cleanup Team 負責在最終移交前逐一解決這些問題。
blocks.en: Deviation Lists / Punch Lists: Before handover, a list is compiled of all outstanding issues. The Cleanup Team is responsible for resolving these items one by one before Final Handover.

blocks.zh: 三階段移交就像新房交屋：第一階段「預驗收」（Ready to Run），確認硬體完工；第二階段「交鑰匙」（Handover），你可以開始搬進去住了；第三階段「尾款結清」（Final Handover），所有瑕疵修繕完畢、保固書交接、裝修公司撤場。每一階段都需要雙方簽字確認。
blocks.en: The three-step handover is like taking over a new home: the first step, "pre-acceptance" (Ready to Run), confirms that the hardware is complete; the second step, "key handover" (Handover), is when you can move in; the third step, "final payment" (Final Handover), is when all defects have been repaired, the warranty papers handed over, and the contractor has left the site. Each step needs sign-off from both parties.

blocks.zh: PQ/PV 的銜接規劃：PEP 明確指出 PQ/PV 不在此專案範圍內，但 SEC 建議業主提前組建 PQ 支援團隊。這是非常務實的建議——許多專案在 OQ 完成後才發現沒有足夠的內部能力執行 PQ，導致產品上市時間延遲。CDMO 在承接 SUS 專案時，應在 PEP 階段就將 PQ/PV 的人力和資源需求納入規劃。
blocks.en: Planning the link to PQ/PV: The PEP states explicitly that PQ/PV is outside the scope of this project, but the SEC advises the owner to set up a PQ support team early. This is very pragmatic advice: many projects discover only after OQ that they lack the internal capability to execute PQ, which delays time to market. When taking on an SUS project, a CDMO should include the manpower and resource needs for PQ/PV in the plan at the PEP stage.

blocks.zh: 提前使用的風險管控：如果業主在正式移交前就需要使用設施，PEP 要求進行現場檢查並簽訂操作和維護責任協議。這是為了釐清責任界線，避免在出現問題時產生歸責爭議。
blocks.en: Risk control for early use: If the owner needs to use the facility before formal handover, the PEP requires a site inspection and a signed agreement on operation and maintenance responsibilities. This clarifies the boundary of responsibility and avoids disputes over accountability when problems arise.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，Handover 階段是專案成功與否的關鍵時刻。建議在 PEP 中加入「知識轉移計畫 (Knowledge Transfer Plan)」，確保 SEC 的技術團隊在撤出前將所有操作知識和維護經驗傳授給 CDMO 的運營團隊。尤其是 SUS 專案中一次性組件的安裝技巧、無菌連接操作和故障排除經驗，這些「隱性知識」往往比書面文件更有價值。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, the Handover phase is the critical moment that decides whether the project succeeds. It is advisable to add a "Knowledge Transfer Plan" to the PEP to make sure the SEC's technical team passes all operating knowledge and maintenance experience to the CDMO's operations team before withdrawing. In SUS projects especially, the installation techniques for single-use components, aseptic connection practices, and troubleshooting experience are "tacit knowledge" that is often more valuable than written documents.

blocks.zh: 為什麼要設計三階段移交而非一次移交？每個階段的關鍵交付物是什麼？
blocks.en: Why design a three-step handover rather than a single handover? What are the key deliverables of each step?

blocks.zh: 如果 Final Handover 時仍有未解決的偏差，應該如何處理？能否帶偏差移交？
blocks.en: If unresolved deviations remain at Final Handover, how should they be handled? Can the handover proceed with open deviations?

blocks.zh: SEC 在 PQ/PV 階段提供支援時，為什麼要「在 Company X 的監督和管理下」工作？
blocks.en: Why must the SEC work "under the supervision and management of Company X" when providing support in the PQ/PV phase?

blocks.zh: 9.12 Abbreviations 9.12 縮寫
blocks.en: 9.12 Abbreviations

blocks.zh: 此縮寫表是 PEP 的標準組成部分。在實際專案中，建議將縮寫表放在 PEP 的開頭（而非附錄），因為讀者在閱讀過程中需要頻繁查閱。
blocks.en: This abbreviation list is a standard component of a PEP. In an actual project, it is advisable to place the abbreviation list at the beginning of the PEP (rather than in an appendix), because readers need to consult it frequently while reading.

blocks.zh: 特別注意以下縮寫在 SUS 專案中的特殊意義：
blocks.en: Pay particular attention to the special meaning of the following abbreviations in SUS projects:

blocks.zh: GEP (Good Engineering Practice / 良好工程實務)：適用於 No-Impact 系統的驗證標準
blocks.en: GEP (Good Engineering Practice): The standard applied to No Impact systems

blocks.zh: BSL (Biosafety Level / 生物安全等級)：在基因治療產品製造中是關鍵設計參數
blocks.en: BSL (Biosafety Level): A key design parameter in gene therapy product manufacturing

blocks.zh: SEC (Supervising Engineering Contractor / 監督工程承包商)：此範例中的核心執行角色
blocks.en: SEC (Supervising Engineering Contractor): The core executing role in this example

blocks.zh: GEP 和 GMP 的區分是理解 C&Q 策略的關鍵：GEP 適用於不直接影響產品品質的系統，要求較低但仍需文件化；GMP 適用於直接影響產品品質的系統，要求正式的確效文件和審批流程。在 SUS 專案中，正確區分兩者可以顯著降低確效工作量和成本。
blocks.en: The distinction between GEP and GMP is the key to understanding the C&Q strategy: GEP applies to systems that do not directly affect product quality, with lower requirements that still need to be documented; GMP applies to systems that directly affect product quality, with formal validation documentation and approval processes. In an SUS project, distinguishing the two correctly can significantly reduce validation workload and cost.

blocks.zh: 9.13 References 9.13 參考文獻
blocks.en: 9.13 References

blocks.zh: PEP 的配套文件體系：PEP 不是一份孤立的文件，它與多份配套文件共同構成完整的專案管理框架：
blocks.en: The PEP's supporting document system: The PEP is not an isolated document; together with several supporting documents it forms a complete project management framework:

blocks.zh: Level A Time Schedule（主時程表）：專案的最高層級時程，標示關鍵里程碑
blocks.en: Level A Time Schedule: The highest-level project schedule, showing key milestones

blocks.zh: QAP：品質活動的詳細計畫
blocks.en: QAP: The detailed plan for quality activities

blocks.zh: VMP：驗證策略的最高指導文件
blocks.en: VMP: The top-level guiding document for the validation strategy

blocks.zh: Object Breakdown Structure（設備分解結構）：將設施拆解為可管理的單元
blocks.en: Object Breakdown Structure: Breaks the facility down into manageable units

blocks.zh: Procurement Strategy（採購策略）：定義供應商選擇和採購流程
blocks.en: Procurement Strategy: Defines supplier selection and the procurement process

blocks.zh: 在 SUS 專案中，Procurement Strategy 特別重要，因為一次性組件的供應商選擇直接影響製程設計和產品品質。採購策略需要考慮：供應商的法規合規狀態、組件的 E&L (Extractables & Leachables) 數據可用性、供應鏈穩定性（單一供應商風險）以及交貨前置時間。
blocks.en: In an SUS project, the Procurement Strategy is especially important because the choice of single-use component suppliers directly affects process design and product quality. The procurement strategy needs to consider the supplier's regulatory compliance status, the availability of E&L (Extractables & Leachables) data for the components, supply chain stability (single-supplier risk), and delivery lead time.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: PEP 是 SUS 專案的核心管理文件：它定義了專案範圍、執行策略、組織架構、品質管控和時程規劃，是所有利害關係人的共同依據
blocks.en: The PEP is the core management document of an SUS project: It defines the project scope, execution approach, organization, quality control, and schedule planning, and is the common basis for all stakeholders

blocks.zh: 活文件特性：PEP 隨專案進展持續更新，每次重大變更需經正式審核與批准程序
blocks.en: Living document: The PEP is updated continuously as the project progresses, and every major change requires a formal review and approval process

blocks.zh: Impact Assessment 決定 C&Q 深度：Direct Impact 系統需完整 IQ/OQ，Indirect Impact 需 FAT/SAT + Commissioning，No Impact 僅需 GEP 級調試
blocks.en: Impact Assessment determines the depth of C&Q: Direct Impact systems need full IQ/OQ, Indirect Impact systems need FAT/SAT plus commissioning, and No Impact systems need only GEP-level commissioning

blocks.zh: SEC 與業主的分工界線：SEC 負責設計、施工、採購和確效（至 OQ），業主負責 VMP 制定、PQ/PV 執行和後續運維
blocks.en: Dividing line between the SEC and the owner: The SEC is responsible for design, construction, procurement, and validation (up to OQ); the owner is responsible for developing the VMP, executing PQ/PV, and subsequent operation and maintenance

blocks.zh: 三階段移交機制：Ready to Run → Handover → Final Handover，確保責任有序轉移、文件完整交接
blocks.en: Three-step handover mechanism: Ready to Run → Handover → Final Handover, ensuring an orderly transfer of responsibility and a complete handover of documentation

blocks.zh: SUS 專案的特殊考量：一次性組件的 shelf life 管理、E&L 數據需求、供應商單一來源風險，以及清潔驗證範圍的簡化
blocks.en: Special considerations for SUS projects: Shelf life management of single-use components, E&L data needs, single-source supplier risk, and the simplified scope of cleaning validation

blocks.zh: 品質文件層級：VMP（憲法）→ QAP（法律）→ IQ/OQ Protocols（SOP），逐級承接且不得矛盾
blocks.en: Quality document hierarchy: VMP (constitution) → QAP (law) → IQ/OQ Protocols (SOP), each level building on the one above without contradiction

blocks.zh: 風險管理貫穿全程：從 BD 到 DD 分階段進行風險分析，涵蓋專案風險、GMP/BSL 風險和 HSE 風險
blocks.en: Risk management throughout: Risk analysis is performed in phases from BD to DD, covering project risk, GMP/BSL risk, and HSE risk
